data.standardized_narrative: The 2017 annual report records a significant underwriting loss driven by third-quarter US hurricanes (Harvey, Irma and Maria). The document discusses large catastrophe losses and an elevated combined ratio; the report does not provide a clearly labelled GROSS prior-year reserve movement amount in accessible pages, so no gross prior-year release/strengthening figure could be extracted with confidence. Primary drivers mentioned are natural catastrophe events and related large loss development.
raw_causal_phrases: the third quarter hurricanes of Harvey, Irma and Maria
the results for the year were a loss of GBP 82.0m (2016 profit of GBP 22.2m)
data.data_quality_notes: Many required reserve-specific figures (gross opening claims outstanding, gross prior-year movement, technical reserves reconciliation) could not be confidently read from the provided scanned pages. The balance sheet and technical provisions pages exist in the file but the numeric cells are not reliably legible in the images supplied; therefore opening_reserves and prior_year_development are returned as null. Gross written premium was readable on the statement of profit and loss (page 10). No clearly labelled GROSS 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' numeric total was found in the accessible/legible text; P&L "Claims incurred in relation to prior underwriting years" lines were ignored per instructions. If higher-resolution scans of the Balance Sheet (Technical provisions: 'Claims outstanding' line) or the Technical Provisions movement table are provided, the missing gross reserve figures and prior year development can likely be extracted.
